_doc: Camera keys (kit 03_CAMERA_GRAMMAR): each key LANDS on its word ('palavra#n' = n-th occurrence, or seconds). move: cut | travel | whip | fly. dur = seconds of the move ending on the word. Poses live in src/camera.ts.
